summary.text: Tamara Trujillo of Cheyenne, a Constitution Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of State of Wyoming to Robert Short.
She describes a career with the state Child Support Division and 17 years in accounting and procurement at the Cheyenne refinery.

paragraphs.text: Tamara Trujillo moved to Cheyenne at age two and graduated from Cheyenne Central High School.
She began her career with the State of Wyoming's Child Support Division, where she prepared case files and wrote operational procedures.
Later, married to a military spouse, she served as a Naval Air Station ombudsman.

Trujillo returned to Wyoming in 2006 to raise her children and worked for 17 years in accounting and procurement at the Cheyenne refinery, where she was a Contractor Admin. Coordinator who audited contracts.
She lives in the house she grew up in, which she bought 10 years ago.
She received 8.4% of the vote to Robert Short's 67.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
